label: Kestrel Arts Alliance — Studio Pathways
covers: Every item carries an inline 'Label:' category prefix with no bullet marker, the shape PR #9 added promoteInlineColonLabels for. The items must stay in their own columns whatever happens to the labels; scoring ignores group names, so a correct promotion and a correct non-promotion both pass.

slides.title: Kestrel Arts Alliance — Studio Pathways Logic Model

columns.heading: INPUTS
items: Staffing: One studio manager and three teaching artists on contract
Staffing: A part-time administrator covering intake and scheduling
Facilities: A ceramics studio and a shared darkroom on Kestrel Street
Funding: A three-year city arts grant renewed each April

columns.heading: ACTIVITIES
items: Instruction: Twelve-week studio courses in ceramics and photography
Instruction: Open studio hours four afternoons a week
Outreach: Portfolio review clinics for applying secondary students
Outreach: An annual exhibition of participant work at the city library

columns.heading: OUTPUTS
items: Participation: Ninety young people completing at least one studio course
Participation: Six hundred open studio visits logged across the year
Product: Forty finished portfolios assembled and reviewed

columns.heading: SHORT-TERM OUTCOMES
items: Skills: Participants demonstrate competent use of studio equipment
Confidence: Participants describe themselves as artists to their peers

columns.heading: LONG-TERM OUTCOMES
items: Pathways: Participants apply to arts programmes after secondary school
Community: Kestrel Street sustains a visible community of young makers
